Juliana spearheaded the migration of our legacy payment gateway to a microservices architecture, coordinating 12 engineers across three teams. She designed a CI/CD pipeline that cut deployment cycles from 48 hours to 12, using GitHub Actions to automate testing. When a critical database query bottleneck threatened a major client launch, she restructured the schema, reducing latency by 40% and avoiding a $200K potential loss.  

As a skip-level manager, I’ve observed Juliana’s work through cross-team collaborations, particularly her role in aligning engineering priorities with product roadmaps. Her ability to translate complex technical decisions into stakeholder-aligned outcomes has been pivotal in two high-stakes product launches.  

Juliana’s strength lies in her strategic mindset and leadership. She mentored three junior engineers, whose teams achieved 30% faster issue resolution post-training. Her system design for our fraud detection platform, which integrated real-time analytics, reduced false positives by 25% and became a benchmark for internal teams. She thrives in Agile environments, balancing technical rigor with stakeholder needs.  

In summary, Juliana is a reliable, results-driven leader who bridges technical excellence with business impact. Her work ethic—relentless, precise, and collaborative—makes her a standout candidate.
